svg.aria-label: Three ways to use more hardware. Shared-memory: one big machine with many CPUs and lots of RAM (scale up). Shared-disk: several machines with their own CPUs and RAM all reading one shared storage array over a fast network, common in some warehouses. Shared-nothing: each node has its own CPU, RAM and disk and they coordinate only over the network (scale out), the default for distributed databases.
